purpose: Manual research requirements that extend the agent beyond solving the current fixed maps. A requirement may be selected only after its named benchmark exists.

requirements.intent: Identify and collect an access resource before committing to a route blocked by a gate.
requirements.metric: positive delivery score without holdout regression

requirements.intent: Estimate route energy and recharge before a parcel route becomes infeasible.
requirements.metric: positive delivery score without holdout regression

requirements.intent: Use visit counts and frontiers to reveal tasks absent from the initial observation.
requirements.benchmark: partial-observation-frontier and partial-observation-backtrack, each with mirror holdout
requirements.metric: task discovery rate, dead-end recovery, and steps-to-first-delivery on unseen seeds

requirements.intent: Replan around changing obstacles and compare A*, weighted A*, and learned cost estimates.
requirements.metric: success rate, path cost, and replanning latency on holdout seeds

requirements.intent: Coordinate task claims, prevent duplicate pickups, and balance workload among agents.
requirements.metric: team reward, duplicate-work rate, and fairness on holdout seeds

requirements.intent: Train or adapt a navigation cost heuristic from traces while retaining deterministic safety fallback.
requirements.benchmark: seeded train-test routing suite (to be added)
requirements.metric: holdout success must match A* fallback; compare path cost and decisions per second
